block.detail: Names of the workflow blocks to execute, separated by commas, e.g. Load orders, Report. Leave empty to execute the whole workflow.

buttonText.detail: Text on the button. If empty: Execute

refreshFromSource.detail: On: the blocks reload their data from the sources. Off: data already loaded upstream is reused where possible.
refreshFromSource.documentation:
If ticked, Omniscope discards any previous execution data and reloads fresh data from the sources.

If unticked, Omniscope executes only the blocks that need it, based on their current configuration and previous execution data, and reuses data from upstream blocks where available.

showJobState.detail: Show the execution's progress (queued, running, finished) under the button. Errors are always shown.
